import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int N, total;
    static int[][] P = new int[7][7];
    static long[][] dp_state = new long[2][70003];
    static int[][] transition = new int[70003][128];
    static int[] probability = new int[128];
    static long inv100;
    static Map<BitSet, Integer> node_id = new HashMap<>();
    static int[] nodeSize = new int[1]; // to keep track of total nodes
    static int[] nodeIdArray = new int[70003]; // to map node id to index
    static int[] nodeIndex = new int[70003]; // reverse mapping
    static BitSet[] nodeBitsets = new BitSet[70003];

    static long mod_pow(long base, int exp) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int dfs(BitSet x) {
        if (node_id.containsKey(x)) {
            return node_id.get(x);
        }
        int id = ++nodeSize[0];
        node_id.put((BitSet) x.clone(), id);
        nodeBitsets[id] = (BitSet) x.clone();

        BitSet[] tmp = new BitSet[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            tmp[i] = new BitSet(1 << N);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); j++) {
                if (((j & (1 << i)) != 0)) {
                    tmp[i].set(j | (1 << i));
                } else {
                    tmp[i].set(j);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
            BitSet temp = (BitSet) x.clone();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                    temp.or(tmp[j]);
                }
            }
            int t = dfs(temp);
            transition[id][mask] = t;
        }
        return id;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        BitSet start = new BitSet(N);
        start.set(0);
        nodeSize[0] = 0;
        node_id.clear();
        nodeBitsets = new BitSet[70003];
        for (int i = 0; i < nodeBitsets.length; i++) {
            nodeBitsets[i] = new BitSet(N);
        }
        int startId = dfs(start);
        inv100 = mod_pow(100, MOD - 2);
        System.err.println("Number of nodes: " + (nodeSize[0]));

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                P[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                // Read input if needed, but in this code, input is already read above
            }
        }

        dp_state[0][startId] = 1;
        int current_layer = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); j++) {
                int prob = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) {
                    int p_value = ((j & (1 << k)) != 0) ? P[i][k] : 100 - P[i][k];
                    prob = (int)((long)prob * inv100 % MOD * p_value % MOD);
                }
                probability[j] = prob;
            }

            Arrays.fill(dp_state[current_layer ^ 1], 0);
            for (int j = 1; j <= nodeSize[0]; j++) {
                if (dp_state[current_layer][j] != 0) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < (1 << N); k++) {
                        int t = transition[j][k];
                        dp_state[current_layer ^ 1][t] = (dp_state[current_layer ^ 1][t] + dp_state[current_layer][j] * probability[k]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            current_layer ^= 1;
        }

        BitSet final_mask = new BitSet(N);
        final_mask.set(0, N);
        int finalNodeId = node_id.get(final_mask);
        System.out.println(dp_state[current_layer][finalNodeId]);
    }
}
